notes: Source is Contacta's own US product sheet (contactainc.com), which mirrors the UK contacta.co.uk HLD9 datasheet; both show the same rear-panel photo and technical-data table (cross-checked against thunderhearing.com's loop-driver manual page, which independently lists 10A RMS / 36V RMS / single-channel). Rear panel, left to right: POWER (IEC inlet) / STATUS (terminal block) / a PHANTOM-POWER status LED (not a port) / MIC (XLR) / LINE (XLR) / EXPANSION (RJ-style jack) / FEATURE (RJ-style jack) / LOOP (speakON). Mic and Line are combo jacks accepting either XLR or 1/4" TRS. Expansion and Feature are proprietary Contacta interconnect/communications-processor links; the datasheet never names their connector type in text, only the rear-panel photo, so "rj45" is an inferred best-fit and no Ethernet grade is applied (this is not standard Ethernet). No bandwidth-graded connectors (HDMI/SDI/DP/USB/Ethernet-speed) are documented on this device, so no "grade" fields are set anywhere. Unit is a compact desktop chassis (7.87"W x 2.48"H x 10.47"D, 5.51 lbs); Contacta lists an optional Single/Dual Rackmount Kit accessory, but the bare unit isn't inherently rack-mount and its height doesn't cleanly map to a standard U, so rackUnits is omitted. AC mains voltage/current for the built-in PSU is not stated in this datasheet.

ports.name: Mic
ports.note: Input 1 (Microphone): balanced XLR with switchable phantom power, or 1/4" TRS jack for electret mic with 3.3VDC bias via 680Ω load.

ports.name: Line
ports.note: Input 2 (Line): balanced XLR or 1/4" TRS jack to an ohmically isolated input.

ports.name: Loop
ports.note: 4-pole speakON loop output; 10A RMS compliance current @1kHz sine, 36V RMS compliance voltage.

ports.name: Expansion
ports.note: Proprietary Contacta interconnect for linking additional HLD9/Contacta units in perimeter or phased-array configurations (90° phase shift selectable). Datasheet does not name the connector type; rear-panel photo shows an RJ-style modular jack, mapped here as the closest listed connector. Not standard Ethernet, so no grade is set.

ports.name: Feature
ports.note: External monitor & control interface to the Contacta communications processor for remote setup/level control and system interrogation. Rear-panel photo shows an RJ-style modular jack (connector type not explicitly named in the datasheet); not standard Ethernet, so no grade is set.

ports.name: Status
ports.note: Volt-free (dry) relay contacts, SPCO, on a small pluggable screw-terminal block.

ports.name: Power
ports.note: IEC power inlet for the built-in internal power supply; AC voltage/current rating not stated on the datasheet.
